rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for gripping or holding something firmly.

example.english: I clench the handrail while waiting for the bus to stop.
example.traditional: 我等緊巴士停低嗰陣，一路揸實扶手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 gan2 baa1 si2 ting4 dai1 go2 zan6 jat1 lou6 zaa1 sat6 fu4 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone closes their fist tightly.

example.english: They clench their fists as soon as they hear this.
example.traditional: 佢哋一聽到呢句就揸緊拳頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 teng1 dou3 ne1 geoi3 zau6 zaa1 gan2 kyun4 tau4

rows.note: Use this for clenching the teeth or jaw, especially under strain or anger.

example.english: The pain was unbearable, so I had to clench my teeth and tough it out.
example.traditional: 痛到頂唔順，我唯有咬實牙關捱過去。
example.jyutping: tung3 dou3 ding2 m4 seon6 ngo5 wai4 jau5 ngaau5 sat6 ngaa4 gwaan1 ngaai4 gwo3 heoi3
